who: Real stack · local stand-ins for the Google Business Profile API and Slack
title: Every Google review answered, the hard ones by a person
sub: Drafts in the reviewer's language that fit what they wrote, praise answered on its own, criticism and serious claims held for the manager with an alert.
outro: Python · FastAPI · SQLite · Google Business Profile API · Slack webhooks · Docker · e2e in GitHub Actions.

caps.text: New Google reviews for two locations. The serious ones wait for the manager, most urgent first
A food-poisoning claim: an alert went to Slack, and the draft takes it private without repeating the claim
A 2-star review in German: the draft answers each point, the salt, the wait and the price
The manager adds a personal line and posts it to Google
Praise is answered on its own, after a window in which anyone can still edit it
Posted: in English or German, by first name, mentioning what they liked
Per location: rating, how many got a reply, how fast, and what the complaints are about
